note: golden_hash filled by golden-parity.test.mjs --update. tax_year is a REQUIRED input; PARAMS carries the Pub 15-T (2025) and (2026) STANDARD annual schedules and an unsupported year fails closed. Vector 1 (the proven vector) is the 2026 worked example from 0xAlpha/audits/2026-08-23-PAYROLL-2026-CORRECTION-SPEC.md §5 item 4, whose expected figures were computed from the pinned tables independently of this kernel.

vectors.name: biweekly_single_standard_2026
vectors.description: Spec §5 worked example. tax_year 2026, $2,000 biweekly, single/MFS, no Step 3/4 adjustments. Annualized 52,000 less the 8,600 line-1g backout = 43,400 adjusted, landing in the 19,900-57,900 band: 1,240.00 + 23,500*0.12 = 4,060.00 annual = 156.15 biweekly. The 2025 tables returned 161.60 for the same facts.

output_payload.regulatory_basis: IRS Publication 15-T (2026), Section 1, Percentage Method Tables for Automated Payroll Systems and Withholding on Periodic Payments of Pensions and Annuities; Worksheet 1A.
output_payload.note: STANDARD Withholding Rate Schedules only (Form W-4 Step 2 multiple-jobs checkbox not supported). Federal withholding only; not tax advice; state and local withholding out of scope.

vectors.name: unsupported_tax_year_fail_closed
vectors.description: tax_year 2024 is not in PARAMS - the kernel computes nothing, returns error unsupported_or_missing_tax_year and flags FEDERAL_WITHHOLDING_TAX_YEAR_NOT_SUPPORTED. It never falls back to a default edition.

output_payload.note: tax_year is a required input and must be one of the supported editions. No withholding was computed; this kernel does not fall back to a default edition.
